::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Nov 8th 1861  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1861/12
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

I found your MS here yesterday on my return from a two months expedition into Yorkshire and Devonshire. I think it is a pretty bright description, and the history of the contending organs is very entertaining, the only pity is that it is too late for December. I hope you have had a chapter of the [Thorne](other_books/otherbook_275.qmd). I find it is much liked and I am glad to see [you](other_books/otherbook_317.qmd) in the [Churchman](organizations/other_62.qmd). I think I shall soon send you some of [Mrs Grant](cmy_books/cmybook_43.qmd) to look over. I was obliged to abridge her a little to get her into keeping with the rest

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Envelope addressed to Miss Ann Smith/ Rectory/ Old Charlton/ SE and postmarked Winchester 8 November 1861 and London SE 9 November 1861.
